Name: Uppergrade (Bigger Keg Jar Cask and Furnace) (CP)
Author: Molenfeuer
Description:
[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size][list=1]
[*]Download the newest version of this mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/96969738?tab=user+files]NexusMods[/url] or the GitHub [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/Uppergrade/releases]release page[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Extract the ZIP-File and put the folder into the mods folder of SMAPI (mostly located under "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods")
[/list]
[size=5][b]Usage[/b][/size]
Each crafting recipe is unlocked with the base recipe. I.e. if you unlock the keg, you will automatically unlock the double keg!
[size=5][b]
Options & Compatibility
[/b][/size]Available configuration:
[list]
[*]Copy item quality
[list][*]﻿Enabled: The produced item has the same quality as the input item
[*]﻿Auto (default): Like Enabled but only when specific mods are installed (see *️⃣ mark)
[*]﻿Disabled: Disable this feature
[/list][*]Allow cask outside cellar
[/list]Available languages: 🇬🇧 🇩🇪 🇧🇷 🇪🇸 🇨🇳 🇫🇷[b][size=5]
[/size][/b]Compatible with: ✅ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063?tab=description]Automate[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21971]✅ Build More Cellars[/url] *️⃣ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21366]Machines Copy Quality[/url] *️⃣ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23386]Yet Another Quality Goods Mod[/url] *️⃣ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21278]Artisan Goods Keep Quality[/url][b][size=5]

Features
[/size][/b]Did you ever feel like all that vertical space in your sheds and basements are going to waste? That you can stuff just about twice as many fruits and vegetables in your kegs and casks if you just made them taller?

Well, things are looking up! Introducing Upper-Grades for your machines, pushing your machines to new heights! This mods adds FOUR brand new crafting recipes, which can DOUBLE the output for the

[list]
[*]keg
[*]cask
[*]preserve jar
[*]furnace
[/list]with a brand new scientific advancements known as 'putting them ontop of each other' and 'making them longer'.
[i]Note: Due to hardware limitations machines cannot be more than two tiles high, therefore maxxing out the tiles will have to do.[/i][b][size=5]

Contribute[/size][/b]
If something doesn't work, or you miss a feature, feel free to open a new issue on the [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/Uppergrade/issues]GitHub Page of this mod[/url]. I prefer the GitHub Page but if you really don't want to use it feel free to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23823?tab=bugs]Issue Page here on NexusMods[/url].[b]
